content_sections.heading: Collector Office Bastar Principal Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The venue is given in the official notification (see the link below).

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Walk-in date: 21 December 2026, reporting at 10:30 AM Vacancies: 1 How to apply: Attend the walk-in interview Pay: Rs. 65,000 monthly lump sum honorarium, no other allowances Fee: No application fee is mentioned in the notification Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Place: Bastar Academy of Dance, Art and Literature (BADAL), Asna, District Bastar

content_sections.heading: Collector Office Bastar Principal Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.office_of_the_collector_district_bastar_: Rs. 65,000 monthly lump sum honorarium, no other allowances
Bastar Academy of Dance, Art and Literature (BADAL), Asna, District Bastar

Post-graduate examination passed in M.B.A. with minimum 55 percent or more from a recognised institution/university; Diploma/Degree certificate in the field of Dance/Music/Art/Painting/Drama from a recognised institution/university

content_sections.heading: Collector Office Bastar Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 6204/आ.वि./विविध/2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Collector Office Bastar notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post-graduate examination passed in M.B.A. with minimum 55 percent or more from a recognised institution/university; Diploma/Degree certificate in the field of Dance/Music/Art/Painting/Drama from a recognised institution/university Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Candidate must be a native (mool niwasi) of Chhattisgarh State Principal's jurisdiction is limited to the BADAL institution; interference in other management of the Society is prohibited Affidavit in the prescribed format must be submitted

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Post is irregular and fully temporary; no claim for regularisation in any situation Society may abolish the post; service may be ended with notice of abolition and one month's service Candidate may leave with one month's prior notice or one month's remuneration Monthly lump sum honorarium only; no other allowances Character verification and medical fitness certificates within one month of appointment date

content_sections.heading: How Will Collector Office Bastar Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Marks for educational qualification (50 marks) Interview (50 marks) Merit list on combined marks out of 100 50 marks for educational qualification 50 marks for interview Merit list prepared on combined marks out of 100

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form in the prescribed format Age proof certificate All certificates/documents of the required educational qualification Self-attested photocopies Residence (domicile) certificate from competent authority Permanent caste certificate (for SC/ST/OBC claim)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Collector Office Bastar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application format from the Bastar district website https://bastar.gov.in. Attach self-attested copies of age proof and all educational qualification certificates/documents. Attach the residence certificate issued by the competent authority. Submit the application in person on the interview date, 21-12-2026; no other mode is accepted.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No separate intimation will be sent to applicants for the walk-in Applications by any other mode will not be accepted Incomplete, unclear or erroneous applications will be rejected without separate intimation Meeting minimum qualifications does not by itself make a candidate eligible for appointment Decision of the Collector and Chairman, Amcho Bastar Heritage Society, Badal Asna is final in any dispute

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Collector Office Bastar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 21 December 2026, and candidates report at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Collector Office Bastar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Principal.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Collector Office Bastar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 21 December 2026 at 10:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 65,000 monthly lump sum honorarium, no other allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post-graduate examination passed in M.B.A. with minimum 55 percent or more from a recognised institution/university; Diploma/Degree certificate in the field of Dance/Music/Art/Painting/Drama from a recognised institution/university.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be a native (mool niwasi) of Chhattisgarh State. Principal's jurisdiction is limited to the BADAL institution; interference in other management of the Society is prohibited. Affidavit in the prescribed format must be submitted.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Marks for educational qualification (50 marks). Interview (50 marks). Merit list on combined marks out of 100. 50 marks for educational qualification.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post is irregular and fully temporary; no claim for regularisation in any situation. Society may abolish the post; service may be ended with notice of abolition and one month's service. Candidate may leave with one month's prior notice or one month's remuneration.
